headline: NOVOAir flight with PM's adviser makes emergency landing in Dhaka
summary: A technical glitch forced a NOVOAir aircraft carrying Adviser Humayun Kabir to land unexpectedly in the capital.
details: A NOVOAir flight carrying Humayun Kabir, an adviser to the Prime Minister, was forced to make an emergency landing in Dhaka due to a technical glitch.
The aircraft encountered technical issues during the flight, prompting the crew to prioritize safety and return to the capital.
The emergency landing was executed successfully, and no injuries were reported among the passengers or crew members.
Aviation authorities are expected to investigate the cause of the technical failure to prevent future occurrences.
caption:
A technical glitch forced a flight carrying a PM adviser to make an emergency landing in Dhaka.

A NOVOAir flight carrying Humayun Kabir, an adviser to the Prime Minister, was forced to make an emergency landing in Dhaka due to a technical glitch.

The aircraft encountered technical issues during the flight, prompting the crew to prioritize safety and return to the capital.

The emergency landing was executed successfully, and no injuries were reported among the passengers or crew members.

Aviation authorities are expected to investigate the cause of the technical failure to prevent future occurrences.

headline: Jagannath University issues show-cause to four students over Taliban flag incident
summary: The university administration has taken action against students following the reports of a Taliban flag being hoisted on campus.
details: Jagannath University (JnU) has issued show-cause notices to four students in connection with the hoisting of a Taliban flag on campus.
The university administration took this step after the incident sparked concerns regarding campus security and the promotion of extremist ideologies.
The students are now required to explain their involvement in the incident to the university authorities.
The university has emphasized its commitment to maintaining a peaceful and academic environment on campus.
